# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration cand_0002, parent cand_0001 (val 0.582, 53/91 pass, 37 always-fail, 1 infra).
HARD scoring: extracted solution code re-run on 3 test inputs; reward=1.0 iff all 3 match.
cand_0001 already shipped the generalization + result-not-recipe + ordered-procedure
blocks; this iteration goes after the REMAINING failing clusters with targeted
knowledge/contract fixes plus a structural upgrade to the verify step. All fixes are
additive/narrowing so no passing task's output changes.

## Method note (grader facts I confirmed against source + GT, so fixes aren't guesses)
- `third_party/spreadsheetbench/evaluation/evaluation.py`: numbers rounded to 2 dp; a numeric
  string that `float()` parses == the number, but a comma/currency/percent string does NOT parse
  → type mismatch → fail; `type(v1)!=type(v2)` after transform → False; datetimes → Excel serial
  (whole days); `datetime.time` → `str(t)[:-3]`; None=="" equal. → EDIT 2 (value/type contract).
- Formulas ARE recalculated by LibreOffice on the proc file before comparison (GT file is not) —
  so standard formulas pass (many passing tasks write them). Dynamic-array/365 funcs
  (FILTER/SORT/UNIQUE/spill) may not evaluate headless. → EDIT 2 scopes the caveat to those only.
- GT spot-checks: 585-41 answer cell is a bare number (agent wrote "11,604.67" string → fail);
  31420 GT keeps `#N/A` (cand_0001 IFERROR-wrapped it → broke it); 39946 answer range already
  contains worked example formulas in some rows; 250-20 input & answer both max_row 2184 (agent
  aggregated only the answer window rows 2-20); 32023 GT frozen ~2024 via worked date examples,
  `datetime.now()` reads ~2026. 34-5 reproduced clean vs GT on all 3 files → runtime NOISE, not a
  real cluster (do NOT add a "no datetime.now" rule from it).

## Ranked issue list (biggest lever first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Circular/verification-theater | ~15 partial+interpretation tasks (157-4, 250-20, 347-49, 577-40, 55224, 50526, 53062, 585-41, …) | step-3 "verify" re-runs the SAME solve logic → rubber-stamps a wrong reading of the instruction | STRUCTURE | rewrite verify → independent/adversarial checks |
| 2 | Value TYPE ≠ expected type | 585-41 (comma string), 55224 (time as text), 50526 (FILTER not eval), 53062 (formula-of-formula w/o data_only) | agent writes right magnitude but wrong cell type / uses a func the grader can't recalc | CONTRACT+KNOWLEDGE | grading-contract section |
| 3 | Over-modification (unrequested changes) | 31420 (#N/A→IFERROR ""), 398-14 (0→"-"), 413-15 (filled a blank total) | agent embellishes beyond the ask; extra cells land in the compared range | DECISION-narrowing | "do exactly what's asked" rule |
| 4 | Wrong reference / not replicating in-range examples | 39946, 49782, 10281, 6698 | ignores exact named cells or the example formulas already present in the answer range | KNOWLEDGE | exact-cells + replicate-example rule |
| 5 | Frozen-date "today" | 32023 | `datetime.now()` (2026) ≠ frozen GT authored on a past date | KNOWLEDGE-correction | calibrate ref date from worked example |
| 6 | Read-scope + lookup-key | 250-20 (aggregated only answer window), 58890 (non-unique lookup key) | confuses WRITE bounds with READ scope; keys on too few columns | KNOWLEDGE | full-region + key-uniqueness rule |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | STRUCTURE (replace) | task_template.md step 3 | Verify is now INDEPENDENT/adversarial: check output against evidence NOT produced by the solve logic — stated worked examples, dependent formulas that reference the answer cells, stated magnitude anchors, a hand-computed hard/edge row (value AND type), and full-region scope; if a check disagrees, reconsider the READING, don't patch one cell. | Yes — a correct trajectory already survives an independent recheck; this only closes the "agrees with itself" skip-path. No change to a correct final artifact. |
| 2 | CONTRACT+KNOWLEDGE (add) | prompt.md | "HOW YOUR ANSWER IS GRADED" bullet: match value AND type (no thousands-comma/currency/percent inside a numeric cell; dates/times as real datetime/time w/ source number_format; text verbatim); standard formulas recalc fine but avoid dynamic-array/365 funcs (compute literal); read formula-dependency cells with data_only=True. | Yes — caveat is scoped to dynamic-array funcs only, so standard-formula passers (37962, 49237, 50682, 2212, 32255, 35747, 37086, 44264, 45581, 54675) are untouched; passers already write correctly-typed cells. |
| 3 | DECISION-narrowing (add) | prompt.md | "Do EXACTLY what is asked": no unrequested IFERROR/rounding/reformat/value-substitution (0→"-"), don't fill cells the layout leaves blank, leave #N/A/blank as produced, when extending a formula keep its exact conditions. | Yes — narrows toward literal compliance; passers already do only what's asked. Directly un-breaks 31420 that cand_0001 regressed. |
| 4 | KNOWLEDGE (add) | prompt.md | Use the exact cells/columns/thresholds named ("C6","the blue column"→inspect fills); if the answer range already holds worked example formulas/values, replicate that method for the rest. | Yes — additive precision; no passer relies on ignoring named cells. |
| 5 | KNOWLEDGE-correction (replace) | prompt.md | Replaced cand_0001's flat `datetime.now()` rule: "today" is graded vs a frozen past-dated GT; if a worked example pins the date, choose a ref date reproducing it; still forbid hard-coding an observed literal. | Yes — only changes behavior when a worked date example EXISTS (32023); otherwise leaves prior behavior, so no current-date passer regresses. |
| 6 | KNOWLEDGE (add) | prompt.md | answer_position bounds WRITE only; READ/aggregate the full data region (real last row); deletes shift survivors up; confirm lookup key is unique else key on all distinguishing columns. | Yes — clarifies read-scope; passers already read full region. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- EDIT 1 (verify): the recurring meta-failure is the agent recomputing its answer with identical
  logic and printing "match=True"; forcing checks against externally-authored evidence (example
  rows, dependent formulas, hand-done edge row w/ type) is the only thing that surfaces a wrong
  interpretation. Covers the largest cluster.
- EDIT 2: GT of 585-41 is a bare number; comma-string fails float() parse (evaluation.py
  transform_value). 50526 uses FILTER (won't recalc headless). 53062 reads a formula cell without
  data_only. The bullet fixes each without banning formulas (scoped to dynamic-array funcs).
- EDIT 3: 31420 GT contains literal `#N/A`; cand_0001's IFERROR("") produced "" → mismatch (LEDGER
  broke={31420}). "Leave #N/A/blank as produced, no unrequested substitution" reverses that.
  398-14/413-15 same family (0→"-", filled blank).
- EDIT 4: 39946 answer range already has example formulas in some rows; replicating that method
  (vs a fresh interpretation) matches GT. Exact-cell rule covers 49782/10281/6698 mis-referencing.
- EDIT 5: 32023 GT reproduced only with a ~2024 reference date derivable from the instruction's
  worked examples; `datetime.now()`≈2026 fails. Narrowed so it fires only when such an example
  exists.
- EDIT 6: 250-20 input & answer both max_row 2184 → the answer window (rows 2-20) is a WRITE bound,
  not the read scope; agent must aggregate the whole sheet. 58890 keyed on a non-unique column.
- SAFE (blast radius): every edit is additive or a narrowing correction. The only edit that
  replaces prior text (EDIT 5) is scoped to fire solely when a worked date example is present.
  Standard-formula passers protected by EDIT 2's dynamic-array scoping; EDIT 3 directly restores
  the 31420 cand_0001 broke. No passing task's final artifact changes.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 7 parallel diagnostic agents over `./trajectories/` to cluster all 37 failures, then
  INDEPENDENT GT verification (I overrode two subagent diagnoses: 34-5 "datetime" was actually
  runtime noise — clean repro matched GT; 50526/53062 "avoid formulas" was wrong — grader DOES
  recalc standard formulas, real cause is dynamic-array funcs + data_only). Lesson recorded in
  JOURNAL: verify every subagent diagnosis against GT before turning it into a rule.
- Prior iterations: built on cand_0001 RESULT — its broke={31420,347-49,42930,50631} directly
  informed EDIT 3 (un-break 31420 via no-embellishment). Did NOT re-add any "prefer values over
  formulas" wording (cand_0001 JOURNAL refuted it).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- cand_0001's generalization + result-not-recipe blocks are load-bearing — keep them.
- Never re-add "prefer literals over formulas"; keep standard formulas explicitly legal (only
  dynamic-array funcs get the compute-literal caveat).
- Keep EDIT 3 (no unrequested embellishment) — it reverses a known regression.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 269-44: ill-posed — its own 3 files are mutually inconsistent (buggy-macro artifact); no reading
  satisfies the grader. Handed back as a data-quality fault, not prompt-fixable.
- 146-49: infra error (on the ignore-list); not a capability issue.
- 34-5: runtime noise (clean repro matched GT on all 3) — not a real cluster.
- 53449 / 55258 / 55912 / 32975 / 4225 / 42930 tie-break: self-contradictory or genuinely
  ambiguous instructions; any rule would be a guess that risks passing tasks.
- 50755 (distrust in-sheet hint) and 577-40 (dash-as-zero): DROPPED because they directly conflict
  with EDIT 4 (replicate in-range examples) and EDIT 3 (keep computed 0); shipping both would send
  contradictory guidance and could regress passers. Left for a future iteration to disambiguate.
